Strings.application_deployments.title: Application Deployments
Strings.application_deployments.subtitle: Deploy containerized applications on the server. A deployment replaces the running instance only after the new one is healthy.
Strings.application_deployments.login_required: Application Deployments needs a signed-in connection to the RelaxKonOS Server.
Strings.application_deployments.no_selection: Select an application to see its revisions, operations, and logs.
Strings.application_deployments.revisions_hint: A revision is immutable. Rolling back returns to a published revision instead of rebuilding it.
Strings.application_deployments.field.name: Name
Strings.application_deployments.log_truncated: Output was truncated; the newest lines are shown.
Strings.application_deployments.log_empty: No log output has been loaded yet.
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.title: Deployment
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.subtitle: Define the application, then queue one durable deployment operation.
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.step_entr: 2. Where does the code or image come from?
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.name_rule: 3–40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen, or underscore; must start with a letter or digit.
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.base_imag: optional; the template default is used when empty
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.host_port: Publishing on the host loopback is what lets the proxy and the health check reach the container.
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.secrets_n: A secret name without a value keeps the stored version. Values are delivered as read-only files inside the container.
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.site_hint: leave empty for no proxy integration
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.site_note: A route is added to the existing site and validated before it is saved. It needs a host port.
Strings.application_deployments.wizard.deploy_no: Publish a revision and deploy it now
Strings.application_deployments.preview_replacem: Deploying stops the current instance and replaces it once the new one is healthy.
Strings.application_deployments.status.no_permis: This account may not view deployed applications.
Strings.application_deployments.confirm_delete: Delete {0} and its containers? Managed volumes are kept.
